text: Qatar Racing, 'the global horse racing and breeding operation of the QIPCO group' led by HH Sheikh Fahad Al Thani, became title sponsor of British Champions Day on 4 August 2026 for three years, with individual sponsorship of all seven races, succeeding its parent company QIPCO, chaired by his brother HH Sheikh Hamad Al Thani.
short: Qatar Racing replaces parent QIPCO as British Champions Day title sponsor (3 years)
